tools.name: brc_list_allocation_resolvers
tools.description: Returns transactions eligible for allocation from the specified sender book transaction. Use this before updating allocations so the user can see which receiver transactions are available. Requires bookTranId.

tools.name: brc_update_allocations
tools.description: Creates or updates allocations for a sender book transaction. Use brc_list_allocation_resolvers first to identify eligible receiver transactions. Do not call with confirmWrite=true until the user has reviewed the allocation preview and explicitly confirmed posting. Required fields: bookTranId and al

tools.name: brc_list_allocated_transactions
tools.description: Returns transactions already allocated from the specified sender book transaction. Use this to review existing allocations before reversing/deleting one. Requires bookTranId.

tools.name: brc_delete_allocation_resolver
tools.description: Reverses/deletes a single allocation by allocation resolver id. Use brc_list_allocated_transactions first to find the allocation id. Do not call with confirmWrite=true until the user explicitly confirms the reversal/deletion.

tools.name: brc_list_nominal_journal_batches
tools.description: Returns a list of the company's Nominal Journal Batches. Supports optional OData filtering by entryDate and ordering by id. Use this before updating or deleting a nominal journal batch so the user can identify the correct id and timestamp.

tools.name: brc_get_nominal_journal_batch
tools.description: Returns information about a single Nominal Journal Batch by id.

tools.name: brc_create_nominal_journal_batch
tools.description: Creates a new Nominal Journal Batch. The journal should contain balanced debit and credit lines. Do not call with confirmWrite=true until the user has reviewed the preview and explicitly confirmed creation.

tools.name: brc_update_nominal_journal_batch
tools.description: Updates an existing Nominal Journal Batch by id. Use brc_get_nominal_journal_batch first to retrieve the current batch, including timestamp and account transaction line timestamps. Do not call with confirmWrite=true until the user has reviewed the preview and explicitly confirmed the update.

tools.name: brc_delete_nominal_journal_batch
tools.description: Removes an existing Nominal Journal Batch by id. Requires the batch timestamp in Base64 string format. Use brc_get_nominal_journal_batch first to retrieve the current timestamp. Do not call with confirmWrite=true until the user explicitly confirms deletion.

tools.name: brc_list_accruals
tools.description: Returns a list of the company's Accruals. Supports optional OData filtering by entryDate. Supports optional ordering by id.

tools.name: brc_get_accrual
tools.description: Returns information about a single parent Accrual by id. Child accruals are not exposed by the public API.

tools.name: brc_create_accrual
tools.description: Creates a new parent Accrual. The API accepts only the parent transaction shape and relies on shared logic to generate the reversing child transaction. Do not call with confirmWrite=true until the user has reviewed the preview and explicitly confirmed creation.

tools.name: brc_update_accrual
tools.description: Updates an existing parent Accrual by id. Use brc_get_accrual first to retrieve the current accrual and timestamp. Child accruals are not exposed by the public API. Do not call with confirmWrite=true until the user has reviewed the preview and explicitly confirmed the update.

tools.name: brc_delete_accrual
tools.description: Removes an existing parent Accrual by id. Requires the accrual timestamp in Base64 string format. Use brc_get_accrual first to retrieve the current timestamp. Do not call with confirmWrite=true until the user explicitly confirms deletion.

tools.name: brc_list_prepayments
tools.description: Returns a list of the company's Prepayments. Supports optional OData filtering by entryDate. Supports optional ordering by id.

tools.name: brc_get_prepayment
tools.description: Returns information about a single parent Prepayment by id. Child prepayments are not exposed by the public API.

tools.name: brc_create_prepayment
tools.description: Creates a new parent Prepayment. The API accepts only the parent transaction shape and relies on shared logic to generate the reversing child transaction. Do not call with confirmWrite=true until the user has reviewed the preview and explicitly confirmed creation.

tools.name: brc_update_prepayment
tools.description: Updates an existing parent Prepayment by id. Use brc_get_prepayment first to retrieve the current prepayment and timestamp. Child prepayments are not exposed by the public API. Do not call with confirmWrite=true until the user has reviewed the preview and explicitly confirmed the update.

tools.name: brc_delete_prepayment
tools.description: Removes an existing parent Prepayment by id. Requires the prepayment timestamp in Base64 string format. Use brc_get_prepayment first to retrieve the current timestamp. Do not call with confirmWrite=true until the user explicitly confirms deletion.
